header.title: TextMorph
header.description: Morphs titles and labels when the copy changes: outgoing and incoming run together. By default (`effect="up"`) the new line enters from below; `down` comes from above and `fade` is a simultaneous opacity crossfade. Split the copy with `splitBy` (`words` by default, `characters` or `lines`) and cascade tokens with `staggerDelay`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props, switch the title with the buttons and check the generated code. Incoming copy uses the `enter` timing and outgoing uses `exit`.
playground.label: Title

base.title: Basic morph
base.description: With the defaults (`effect="up"`, `splitBy="words"`, `duration={300}`) the outgoing title slides away and the new line morphs in on the same baseline. Pass the copy with `value` (or a string / number as `children`).

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: `up` (default) slides the new copy from below; `down` from above; `fade` is a simultaneous opacity crossfade with no translate. The direction comes from the effect, not from the content.

splitWords.title: By words (splitBy)
splitWords.description: `splitBy="words"` (default) splits the copy into words and keeps whitespace. With `staggerDelay={40}` each word enters a little after the previous one.

splitCharacters.title: By characters
splitCharacters.description: `splitBy="characters"` morphs one code point at a time (`Array.from`), so it respects emoji and characters outside the BMP. Here with `staggerDelay={28}`.

splitLines.title: By lines
splitLines.description: `splitBy="lines"` splits on `\n` and renders each line as a block. With `staggerDelay={60}` the lines cascade.

stagger.title: Cascade delay (staggerDelay)
stagger.description: `staggerDelay` (default `0`) adds milliseconds between tokens on top of enter / exit `delay`. At `0` everything enters together; at `55` you see the cascade.

timing.title: Enter / exit timing
timing.description: `duration` and `easing` accept `{ enter, exit }`: incoming copy uses enter and outgoing uses exit. Here enter takes `420` ms with `emphasized` and exit `240` ms with `exit`.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onTextMorph` reports that the morph started (`reason: "enter"`) and `outTextMorph` that it ended (`exit`), was disabled (`disabled`) or unmounted (`unmount`). If the text changes mid-way, `onTextMorph` does not fire again while it is still `playing`.

disabled.title: Disabled and unmountOnExit
disabled.description: With `isDisabled` (or `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`) the title snaps with no morph. With `unmountOnExit` the outgoing slot is skipped: the swap is instant, with no exit animation.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild` the classes, styles and ref go to the single child (an `h2` here) and its content is replaced by the morph. The copy must go in `value`: children are no longer read as text. The child must be exactly one element.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Classes from `utilities.css` (`gemst-relative`, `gemst-overflow-hidden`, `gemst-block`…) go through `classNames` to adjust layout or overflow without a design system stylesheet. They are already included in `styles.css`.

header.title: TextMorph API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `TextMorph`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every effect, split and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemsitions/text-morph` with its `text-morph.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (except children) and forwards them to the root span, or to the child with asChild. In that case classes and styles merge with the child's and, when both define the same handler (onClick…), the child's runs first. The component adds aria-busy while it animates and aria-live="polite" on the root.

items.live: The root has aria-live="polite", so screen readers announce the new copy when it changes. The incoming slot is what gets read.
items.busy: While the morph runs, the root has aria-busy.
items.outgoing: The outgoing slot has aria-hidden so the old copy is not read on top of the new one.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the text snaps to the final value. The preference is read on every render, not listened to live: if it changes, it applies on the next text change.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds the gemst-ignore-reduced-motion class to the root. Use it only when motion is essential.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a child with the right semantics (h2, strong, label): its content is replaced by the morph and the live region lives on that element.

items.root: Root (`span`). Baseline-aligned `inline-grid` with `overflow: hidden`, `max-width: 100%` and `color: inherit`.
items.effect: Active effect. With `up` and `down` it moves tokens by `--gemst-text-morph-shift`; `fade` only animates opacity.
items.split: Split mode. With `lines`, slots use `white-space: normal` and each token is `display: block`.
items.disabled: Added with `isDisabled`. Tokens have no transition.
items.ready: After mount: enables transitions so the first render does not animate.
items.from: The frame where the new copy paints at its start pose with transitions off.
items.slot: Each morph layer (incoming / outgoing). Both share the same grid cell (`grid-area: 1 / 1`) and use `white-space: pre-wrap`.
items.slotRole: `incoming` uses the `enter-*` variables and sits on top (`z-index: 1`); `outgoing` uses `exit-*` and ignores pointer events.
items.slotState: `in` shows the tokens; `out` hides them and, with `up` or `down`, shifts them by `--gemst-text-morph-shift`.
items.token: Each fragment (`words`, `characters` or `lines`). Transitions `opacity` and `transform`; `transition-delay` adds the stagger on top of the phase delay.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline on every render (as `0ms` with `isDisabled` or reduced motion), except `shift`. Used by the morph tokens.

items.enterDelay: Base delay of the incoming copy. Default `0ms`. Each token adds `index * staggerDelay`.
items.exitDelay: Base delay of the outgoing copy. Default `0ms`.
items.enterEasing: Curve of the incoming copy. Default `standard`.
items.exitEasing: Curve of the outgoing copy. Default `exit`.
items.staggerDelay: Delay between tokens. Default `0ms`. Written inline; the real delay per token is `calc(enter/exit-delay + n * stagger)`.
items.shift: Slide distance for `up` and `down`. Default `0.4em`. Not written inline: override it with a class or `style`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables the CSS uses as defaults.

items.easingStandard: Default for `--gemst-text-morph-enter-easing`. The component writes the resolved curve inline, so redefining the token does not change the animation: use `easing`.
items.easingExit: Default for `--gemst-text-morph-exit-easing`, with the same caveat.

props.title: Props
props.description: Every prop is optional, except `value` when you use `asChild`.

content.title: Content
content.description: The text to display and where it mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Morph type and how the copy is split.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: In milliseconds. `enter` applies to the incoming copy and `exit` to the outgoing one.

state.title: State
state.description: How the morph is turned off or shortened.

items.value: Current text. Required with `asChild`. Without `asChild`, if omitted it falls back to string or number `children`.
items.children: Without `asChild`, a string or number is the copy when `value` is omitted. With `asChild`, it is the root element and its content is replaced by the morph.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles and ref to the single child instead of a `span`. The copy must go in `value`. Without exactly one child element, the morph is not rendered.
items.effect: `up` (default) slides from below; `down` from above; `fade` is a crossfade with no translate.
items.splitBy: `words` (default) splits into words and keeps whitespace; `characters` one code point at a time; `lines` splits on `\n`.
items.duration: Duration. `enter` is for the incoming copy and `exit` for the outgoing one.
items.delay: Wait before each slot starts. Accepts `{ enter, exit }` like `duration`.
items.easing: Token (`standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `emphasized`, `linear`), a CSS timing function or `{ enter, exit }`.
items.staggerDelay: Extra milliseconds between tokens, on top of the phase `delay`. Negative or non-finite values become `0`.
items.isDisabled: Jumps straight to the new text, without a morph. Turning it on mid-way sends `disabled` to `outTextMorph`.
items.unmountOnExit: Skips the outgoing slot: the swap is instant, with no exit animation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only when essential.
items.onTextMorph: Fires when the morph starts (`reason: "enter"`). Does not fire when motion is off.
items.outTextMorph: Fires when it ends (`exit`), is disabled mid-way (`disabled`) or unmounts while animating (`unmount`).
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemst-text-morph-*` variables, which take precedence.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `span`, or the child with `asChild`).
